parameter_role_note: sigma_star is the reduction challenge width, not sampled encryption noise; all Gaussian widths use exp(-pi*x^2/s^2).
public_matrix_representation: explicit uniform arrays, no public expansion seeds
exposure_scope: Channel privacy: one family, intended group, first identity branch and payload length fixed before setup; honest ordinary and outside covert keys may be exposed. Intended covert keys and sender randomness remain private. Ordinary privacy: no honest secret-key disclosure and A1 at every challenge.
assumed_primitive_advantage_bound_for_fi: 2^-192 for every primitive including the enlarged ordinary leaf instance with 126+N_K module samples, at full reduction resources including key-pool and transcript simulation. Estimator costs are not advantage bounds.
registration_interface_scope: The implementation accepts prescribed key-generator outputs in predecomposed form. It does not validate arbitrary untrusted predecomposed public-key encodings and does not claim the full untrusted-registration interface of the source game. A1 is a caller-level assumption for ordinary privacy: the interface does not enforce pairwise distinct selected public-key values or the wrapper one-subregistry-per-identity invariant.
conditional_aggregate_scope: A1 and no honest-key disclosure for ordinary privacy; separately specified channel scope. Ideal independent random words; assumed primitive advantages at complete reduction resources, including the enlarged leaf instance. Implementation requires an additional CSPRNG term.
ordinary_privacy_admissibility: At each challenge, occupied selected leaves have pairwise distinct honest public-key values (A1); inadmissible challenges are rejected in every hybrid. No honest secret key is disclosed. Key generation is not conditioned on collision freedom. Values mean raw vectors in the source and canonical prescribed encodings in the prototype.
ordinary_ind_cpa_gaussian_lwe_coefficien: Total coefficient in the coarser bound with a_G_plus; precise bound splits base and leaf coefficients.
identity_space_scope: Ordinary privacy: registration and challenge identities belong to one nonempty prefix-free identity space; fixed-length encodings suffice. This is a game precondition, not API enforcement or a new restriction on the root-only channel games.
